children: CFO Pulik Richard, an officer of Roivant Sciences, sold 300,000 Common Shares in four transactions on November 10 and 11, 2026, at weighted average prices of $41.20, $41.47, $42.03, and $41.89 per share. The sales totaled $12,473,271. Following the transactions, Richard directly owned 222,046 Common Shares.
